svg.title: Resolve the commitment before comparing the price
svg.desc: Identify the exact chair and fit, read the return policy, resolve contradictions in writing and then compare delivered and conditional return costs.

g.text: Ask what you must be able to undo
Identify the generation, size and configuration
Read the return terms for that exact listing
Separate delivered cost from conditional return cost
Unknown terms stay unknown. A warranty is not a comfort trial. · DeskChairDeals
